mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_feedback ( user_id, feedback_source, feedback_type, feedback_content, correspond_scene, record_date, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{feedbackSource}, #{feedbackType}, #{feedbackContent}, #{correspondScene}, #{recordDate}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_feedback SET feedback_source = #{feedbackSource}, feedback_type = #{feedbackType}, feedback_content = #{feedbackContent}, correspond_scene = #{correspondScene}, record_date = #{recordDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT feedback_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM growth_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY feedback_type
SELECT feedback_source AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM growth_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY feedback_source
